children: The combination brings together both today-and future technology alternative fuel production capability, biomass-to-fuels development and environmental-asset monetization to support domestic energy security, reduced carbon emissions and alternative uses for agricultural waste products.

With the closing of the business combination, XCF is updating its 2027 financial outlook to reflect gross product sales of $650 to 700 million, net revenue of $120- 130 million and EBITDA of $70-75 million.1

XCF believes that the combination will create meaningful shareholder value resulting from combined target 2030 annual gross product sales of more than $1.4 billion, net revenue of more than $400 million and EBITDA of more than $300m.

1 "Please refer to the important note regarding Non-GAAP Measures at the end of this press release for additional information regarding gross product sales. These targets are not projections and are forward-looking statements and are subject to the risks, uncertainties, and assumptions described under "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" below
HOUSTON, TX / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 /
XCF Global Inc. ("XCF")

, a U.S.-based producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel ("SAF"), today announced the completion of its previously announced all-stock business combination with Southern Energy Renewables Inc. ("Southern") and DevvStream Corp. ("DevvStream"). Southern and DevvStream are now wholly owned subsidiaries of XCF, which remains the publicly traded parent company. Following the closing of the transaction, former Southern and DevvStream equity holders hold approximately 20.0% and 10.43%, respectively, of XCF's outstanding common stock. In addition, Chad Langley, John Wharton and Carl Stanton joined the XCF board of directors in connection with the closing of the business combination, while Carter McCain stepped down as a director.

The combination creates a vertically integrated alternative energy platform combining both current and future technology pathways for renewable fuel production, biomass conversion and environmental-asset monetization. Southern complements XCF's HEFA-based New Rise Renewables technology pathway utilizing domestic agricultural waste product feedstocks, with a future gasification technology pathway affording the utilization of even lower cost feedstocks to provide a portfolio of today and future technological capabilities to the company. Additionally, DevvStream brings capabilities to manage and monetize carbon credits, renewable fuel incentives and other environmental attributes, which represent a strategic internal competency for XCF given the revenue generated for the company from these features of its products. The combined platform is designed to source waste and biomass feedstocks regionally, produce fuels near end markets and support local jobs while serving global demand. Its renewable diesel, SAF, renewable methanol and environmental-asset pathways are intended to support aviation, marine, industrial and other hard-to-abate industries using existing infrastructure where possible.

"Today marks an important milestone for XCF as we bring together renewable fuel production, new technology pathways and environmental-asset optimization capabilities on one vertically integrated platform," said Chris Cooper, Chief Executive Officer of XCF Global. "This combination expands our capabilities and supports our strategy to reduce emissions, enhance energy security and resilience, promote alternative uses for domestic agricultural resources, locate production closer to demand and pursue additional value across the alternative renewable fuels chain across our growing global markets. We're excited for this next chapter of growth and development for XCF as we build a leader in the alternative fuel sector."
About XCF Global, Inc.

XCF Global, Inc. is a U.S.-based producer of renewable diesel and SAF focused on decarbonizing transportation while supporting domestic fuel supply, energy security and alternative uses for agricultural waste products. Its New Rise Renewables Reno facility has permitted nameplate capacity of 38 - 40 million gallons per year. XCF trades on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol SAFX. To learn more, visit xcf.global.

Gross product sale

s is a management estimate of the dollar value of the finished renewable fuel product sales in the end-customer markets. XCF believes that this is an important and relevant metric regarding the sales value of the company's products when comparing XCF to other companies. Management defines this as the number of gallons of renewable fuel sold by the Company during a period multiplied by the average observed or derived price in the end-customer market for each product during a period, including government incentives, feedstock, processing and logistics.
EBITDA
is defined as net income (loss) before interest expense, income tax expense (benefit), depreciation and amortization
